numeric_domain: nonnegative real; no invented physiological maxima
evidence_domain: exact, interval (open/closed bounds), unknown; conflicts/unsupported units are not completed by solver

hlh_2004.background_note: no_malignancy retained for clinical review, not a ninth item nor automatic exclusion of malignancy-associated HLH

scope: Original numerical thresholds unchanged; evidence/state identities and temporal node changes preserved. Rule-paths-1.0 supplies source-mapped internal certificates; no terminal-label catalog.

clinical_definitions.fever: 2016/MS enter with current febrile known/suspected sJIA; HLH Table I lists fever without adding duration/temperature cutoffs
clinical_definitions.sjia: Known or clinically suspected systemic juvenile idiopathic arthritis; reported family wording is not itself an independent diagnosis
clinical_definitions.alternative_causes_excluded: Clinical review of other explanations for 2016 laboratory abnormalities; separate from mathematical combination
clinical_definitions.cns: MS source: lethargy, seizures, irritability, confusion, headache, mood changes, coma; use clinically interpreted evidence
clinical_definitions.hemorrhage: MS source: petechiae, ecchymoses/purpura, mucosal or gastrointestinal bleeding, intravascular coagulation; one 0/1 variable
clinical_definitions.active_arthritis: Current active arthritis, not history or arthralgia alone
clinical_definitions.hemophagocytosis: Pathology in bone marrow, spleen or lymph node; site required
clinical_definitions.nk_activity_low: Low/absent functional NK activity per local lab, not NK count/proportion
clinical_definitions.fasting: Confirmed fasting status for reported triglyceride sample; absent/unknown makes TG branch unknown, not negative
clinical_definitions.molecular_hlh: Molecular diagnosis consistent with HLH, not a variant without clinical interpretation
clinical_definitions.infant_under_4_weeks: Age at this observation, only influences Hb cutoff
clinical_definitions.no_malignancy: Clinical background retained; not ninth criterion or automatic denial of malignancy-associated HLH
